Class OutlierDetector

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.loadbalance.OutlierDetector
@Internal public final class OutlierDetector extends Object
The state of the outlier detection of a service, see OutlierDetectionConfiguration: the consecutive failures of each instance, by URI, and until when an instance is ejected.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
